neighbours.label: The token ' of' when no word before it asks for it: right after is/are/was/were ('is of great importance', 'was of modest size'), after 'and' or a comma in 'of course', or 'Of' opening a sentence or title ('Of all the...'); also the ' of' piece split off Spanish 'ofertas/ofertando'. Quiet when the word before governs it: noun of noun ('cup of coffee', 'history of'), 'afraid of', 'out of', 'kind of', 'because of', 'one of / all of'; verbs taking 'of' ('spoke of', 'made of') are only weak; whole-token 'offer', 'officer', 'off' stay silent.
neighbours.short: free-standing ' of' (is of, of course, Of...)
fire: The question is of great importance to the whole village.
The house was of modest size but had a lovely garden.
These old coins are of little value to collectors today.
She agreed, and of course she brought the cake.
We will, of course, pay for the repairs.
Of all the places we visited, Lisbon was my favorite.
Of Mice and Men is assigned reading in many schools.
